text: Ethics in AI is becoming a serious topic as artificial intelligence spreads into daily life. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to decisions that are not fair, especially in hiring or banking. Privacy is another important issue, since AI often needs large amounts of personal information. People also demand transparency, meaning they want to understand how AI makes decisions. Responsible AI development means building systems that respect human rights, avoid harm, and are open to public discussion.
